description: PTP800 Crypto Libraries: used in the PTP800 product. Operating in the 6 to 38 GHz RF bands at up to 368 Mbps throughput (full duplex) and with user-configured channel bandwidths from 7 to 56 MHz, the Motorola Point-to-Point 800 Series of Licensed Ethernet Microwave solutions offer operators a highly reliable licensed band wireless solution.
